text:
The provided evidence is an exploratory qualitative study based on expert interviews and thematic analysis. It investigates how responsible AI is currently viewed and included in ESG investment analyses, concluding that AI is still a relatively unknown topic for investors, taking responsible AI into account is not yet established practice, and bottlenecks/lack of standardized metrics exist. 

The candidate hypothesis posits specific mechanistic interventions (developing novel sub-criteria derived from specific tenets, using AI-powered dynamic weighting tools) and predicts measurable outcomes (yielding a demonstrably more accurate evaluation, mitigating risks, and leading to improved portfolio performance compared to static frameworks). The study did not propose, test, or support this candidate hypothesis.

VERDICT: REJECT
